requirements.title: IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG signaling-NaN and exception rules
requirements.definition: For IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG, a signaling NaN operand signals IEEE_INVALID; unless both operands are signaling NaNs, the signaling NaN is otherwise ignored and not converted to a quiet NaN. No other exceptions are signaled.

pending.IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG-signaling-nan-signals-i: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) for IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG and IEEE_VALUE, N = IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0), F_invalid = IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID, 1.0) for IEEE_SET_FLAG, IEEE_GET_FLAG, and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE, one F_other = IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag, 1.0) branch for each of IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, and IEEE_INEXACT, and H = IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_INVALID) for IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE. Branch D true, N true, F_invalid true, H true: set invalid halting false, clear all five supported flags, evaluate IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG(1.0, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN)) and IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), 1.0), assert IEEE_INVALID true, and assert each supported non-INVALID flag remains false; branch D true, N true, F_invalid true, H false with IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE reporting h false: clear all five supported flags, evaluate both operand orders, assert IEEE_INVALID true, and assert each supported non-INVALID flag remains false; branch D true, N true, F_invalid true, H false with h true: skip; unsupported branches skip.
pending.IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG-single-signaling-nan-ig: Probes D = IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.0) for IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG and IEEE_VALUE, N = IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(1.0), F = IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID, 1.0) for IEEE_SET_FLAG, IEEE_GET_FLAG, and IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE, and H = IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_INVALID) for IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE. Branch D true, N true, F true, H true: set invalid halting false, clear all five supported flags, evaluate IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG(1.5, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN)) and IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), 1.5), assert both results equal 1.5, assert IEEE_INVALID true, and assert each supported non-INVALID flag remains false; branch D true, N true, F true, H false with IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE reporting h false: clear all five supported flags, evaluate both operand orders, assert both results equal 1.5, assert IEEE_INVALID true, and assert each supported non-INVALID flag remains false; branch D true, N true, F true, H false with h true: skip; unsupported branches skip.
pending.IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG-no-other-exceptions: For signaling-NaN rows, use the nonhalting invalid branch from the signaling-NaN plan: clear all five supported flags, evaluate IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG(1.5, IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN)) and IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG(IEEE_VALUE(1.0, IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), 1.5), assert IEEE_INVALID true, and assert supported IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, and IEEE_INEXACT flags remain false. review_rationale: Source registration for 17.11.16-17.11.21: IEEE_LOGB, IEEE_MAX, IEEE_MAX_MAG, IEEE_MAX_NUM, IEEE_MAX_NUM_MAG and IEEE_MIN (batch217). Every unit hash-verified by an independent reviewer across two rounds; each MAX/MIN variant is discriminated from its neighbours by a planned row, NaN handling covers quiet and signaling operands, and exception rows are halting-safe. Source accounting only.
